headline: China Stock Rout Deepens as Corporate Profits Sink and Stimulus Stalls
summary: China's stock market decline deepened as corporate profits sank and major economic stimulus measures remained elusive.
why: As the world's second-largest economy, prolonged equity market contractions and slowing growth in China affect global commodity demand and international investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Deteriorating corporate earnings and the absence of aggressive government stimulus create downward valuation pressure across mainland markets.

why_moved: Disappointing corporate profits and a lack of anticipated government intervention have eroded investor confidence, prompting widespread equity liquidations.
